question: Where can I get cadastral parcel boundaries (geometry) for all of Spain, with parcel identifier and area, as a bulk download or as a queryable service?

answer.summary: Free official GML parcel polygons (with national cadastral reference and area in m2) exist for all of Spain, but in five places: the state Cadastre (DGC) ATOM feed (7,611 municipal zips) and WFS cover everything except Navarra and the three Basque provinces; those four foral cadastres run their own ATOM/WFS, linked from the DGC ATOM index. No single national file; CRS and ID formats differ.
main_caveats: Navarra and the three Basque provinces are NOT in the DGC ATOM/WFS data; they come from four separate foral services with different CRS (4258/25830/3042) and ID schemes.
DGC WFS rejects bboxes above 1 km2 or 5,000 parcels ('Area of extension out of limits'): use ATOM for bulk. Catastro municipality codes differ from INE (Madrid 28900).
Gipuzkoa WFS and ATOM include superseded versions: 292 of 300 sampled WFS parcels had endLifespanVersion filled. Filter for it to be empty.
Licence: DGC permits own use or transformed derived products only, not redistribution of the original data; foral data is CC BY 4.0 (Navarra) or attribution (others).
DGC ATOM refreshes twice a year (feed dated 2026-08-21); WFS is live. Gipuzkoa says data is not an official map and not for certificates.
answer.confidence_reason: Every source was opened and queried this session: zips downloaded and parsed (areas checked against polygons), WFS counts and samples run; only the Sede SHP route and the commercial/academic ones are page-only.

attributes.note: Official parcel polygons are available through the state Cadastre and the four foral cadastres; schemas and access methods differ.
nationalCadastralReference: 14 chars at DGC; foral ones use other formats (Navarra 9 digits, Araba 8, Bizkaia dotted).
areaValue in m2 in every service tested (Araba WFS gives it without uom).
DGC ATOM by municipality; foral ATOM zips. No single all-Spain file.
DGC WFS limited to 1 km2 / 5,000 features per bbox; foral WFS allow count/paging.

sources.name: INSPIRE Cadastral Parcels, ATOM download by municipality (DGC)
sources.publisher: Direccion General del Catastro (Ministerio de Hacienda)
sources.format: GML 3.2 (INSPIRE CP 4.0) inside zip, one zip per municipality with cadastralparcel.gml, cadastralzoning.gml and ISO metadata
sources.license: Free use with attribution to DGC; licence for transformed products only (https://www.catastro.hacienda.gob.es/webinspire/documentos/Licencia_en.pdf); IDEE record also says CC BY 4.0 DG Catastro
sources.summary: INSPIRE Cadastral Parcels, ATOM download by municipality (DGC)
sources.coverage_note: All of Spain except Navarra and Basque Country (Araba, Bizkaia, Gipuzkoa); includes Canarias, Ceuta, Melilla. 7,611 municipalities with unique codes in 52 territorial-office feeds.
caveats: The complete reading traps, inclusion rules, units and access evidence are in the detail. The main caveats of this card also apply.

example.example_request: curl -sL "https://www.catastro.hacienda.gob.es/INSPIRE/CadastralParcels/ES.SDGC.CP.atom.xml" -o cp.atom.xml ; then curl -sL "http://www.catastro.hacienda.gob.es/INSPIRE/CadastralParcels/02/ES.SDGC.CP.atom_02.xml" -o cp_02.xml ; then curl -sL "https://www.catastro.hacienda.gob.es/INSPIRE/CadastralParcels/02/02001-ABENGIBRE/A.ES.SDGC.CP.02001.zip" -o abengibre.zip
example.example_result: National feed: 56 entries (52 DGC offices + 4 foral). Province 02 feed: 87 municipal zips. A.ES.SDGC.CP.02001.zip = 1,089,149 bytes holding cadastralparcel.gml (9.4 MB, 3,837 CadastralParcel, EPSG:25830) e.g. gml:id ES.SDGC.CP.000700100XJ24B areaValue 4127 m2 (polygon area computed from coordinates 4126.6 m2).
